title: Arazzo Workflow Result
description: Schema for machine-readable JSON execution results of arazzo-go workflows.

success.description: True if the workflow and all its required steps succeeded.

durationMs.description: Total execution duration of the workflow in milliseconds.

error.description: Workflow-level error message if failed, or null if successful.

outputs.description: Key-value map of workflow output parameters (redacted for secrets).

steps.description: List of executed step results in execution order.

success.description: True if the step satisfied its success criteria.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the operation.

retries.description: Number of retries attempted before completion.

error.description: Step error message if failed, or null if passed.

outputs.description: Outputs extracted from this step (redacted for secrets).
